requirement_text.REQ-428: Third MOB-4 requirement. Task routes (lib/letflow/routers/tasks.ex): GET /api/v1/tasks/inbox, GET /api/v1/tasks/:id, POST /api/v1/tasks/:id/claim, POST /api/v1/tasks/:id/complete. The task form is resolved through REQ-424's pinned resolver and rendered by REQ-427's form renderer; never the active version. Process-instance renderer: read-only view of GET /api/v1/instances/:id and /api/v1/instances/:id/timeline (lib/letflow/routers/instances.ex) -- status, current step, timeline. No cancel/rebind/advance actions (not in MOB-4). All screens use REQ-426's six-state wrapper; claim/complete errors (409 already claimed, 403, 422) map to its states.

result.summary: Scope test: OUT OF SCOPE -- no tenant-data path touched. `git diff main...HEAD --name-only` shows changes confined to apps/mobile/lib/renderers/task/task.dart, apps/mobile/lib/renderers/process/process.dart, their tests, plus docs/requirements.yaml, docs/status/requirement_status.v25.yaml, lib/letflow/design/req428-task-and-instance-renderer.md (a design doc, not code), and run-bookkeeping handoff JSONs. `grep -rE 'lib/letflow|priv/repo/migrations' <(git diff main...HEAD --name-only)` matches only the design markdown -- zero .ex/.exs changes under lib/letflow/ or priv/repo/migrations/. Checked each scope-test trigger from security-invariants.md / security-reviewer.md against the actual diff: (1) no new/modified tenant-data API route -- lib/letflow/routers/tasks.ex and instances.ex are read-only inputs, unmodified; (2) no migration; (3) nothing resolving a secret -- grep for token/secret/password/apikey in both changed Dart files hits only `tokenId`/`token_id`, which is the process-engine workflow-token concept carried in JSON response bodies (instance/task token identity), not an auth credential or API secret; (4) no server-side response-shaping change for a tenant-scoped entity -- all map-building (task_list_item_map/2, task_detail_map/3, instance_map/1, timeline_item_map/1) lives server-side in already-shipped, unmodified routers; the new Dart code only deserialises what the server already emits; (5) no new lookup-by-ID handler -- the Dart controllers call existing GET /api/v1/instances/:id and GET/POST /api/v1/tasks/:id* endpoints unchanged, via the existing ApiClient/HttpGateway/PostCapableHttpGateway interfaces, no new Dio/transport/secure-storage code (confirmed by reading task.dart and process.dart diffs in full -- claim/complete/load all delegate to `client.get`/`client.post` on the pre-existing gateway abstraction). None of the five triggers fire, so per the scope test this is out of scope and INV-1..INV-8 are not individually run. Recorded per the Applicability note's instruction to check current reality rather than trust stale text: confirmed this file's INV-1 live-now status and INV-2/3/5 S4/S5-landed status do not change the verdict, since the diff never approaches lib/letflow/, migrations, or secrets regardless of which invariants are currently live.
